Both orders create presidential commissions involving labor and management interests to investigate disputes, recommend settlements, and prevent or resolve work interruptions. Most decisively, the child's section 9 closely reproduces C18's unusual emergency-fund provision: an express finding of an emergency affecting the national interest under the same 1961 appropriation, fiscal-year funding from a presidential allotment, continuation through a corresponding fiscal-1962 appropriation, waiver of the same statutory provisions, and later presidential specification of compensation or allowances. C16 has similar labor-dispute and financing provisions but is a less exact match on the fiscal-year language.
